question.problem:
Compute $P(X>7)$ given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{36}x,\, & 3\le x\le 9, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise.}\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
If a continuous random variable $X$ has the probability density function $f(x),$ then 

$$
P(a<X\le b)={\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Since $f(x)$ is identical to zero for all $x>9,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X>7) & ={\int }_{7}^{9}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{7}^{9}\frac{1}{36}x\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{1}{72}{x}^{2}]}_{7}^{9} \\  & =\frac{1}{72}({9}^{2}-{7}^{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{72}(81-49) \\  & =\frac{32}{72} \\  & =\frac{4}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
